clauses.scope_note: License section 1 permits viewing, learning, personal repository copies, personal-use modifications, and use in personal noncommercial projects. Redistribution is addressed separately.
clauses.condition_explanation: personal_or_educational_or_other_noncommercial_purpose means the activity is for one of the stated purposes; not_commercial_use is subject to the restrictions in section 3.

clauses.scope_note: License section 1 permits making personal repository copies and making changes or improvements for personal use; commercial purposes remain restricted by section 3.
clauses.condition_explanation: personal_noncommercial_use means the copying or modification is for personal use and not a commercial purpose.

clauses.scope_note: License sections 1–3 permit noncommercial redistribution, subject to attribution, license-copy, and public-fork-or-derivative link requirements. Commercial redistribution is prohibited absent explicit written permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: appropriate_author_attribution, original_repository_link, changes_indicated, and no_suggestion_of_author_endorsement reflect the attribution terms in section 2. license_copy_included applies to any redistribution. prominent_original_repository_link applies to public forks or derivatives.

clauses.scope_note: Section 1 permits modifications for personal use. Section 3 prohibits commercial use of the software or derivative works without explicit written permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: not_for_commercial_purposes excludes the commercial purposes described in section 3.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3 prohibits commercial use of the software or derivative works without explicit written permission from the copyright holder. Listed examples include selling software or derivatives, use in a commercial product or service, paid services, inclusion in a sold product, and revenue-generating activity.
clauses.condition_explanation: not_explicitly_permitted_in_writing_by_copyright_holder is the exception stated in section 3. Commercial purposes include, but are not limited to, the listed examples.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the software for commercial purposes unless the copyright holder has given explicit written permission.
obligation_items.trigger: When the use is for a commercial purpose, including a listed example, and explicit written permission from the copyright holder has not been given.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3 expressly applies the commercial-purpose restriction to derivative works as well as the software.
clauses.condition_explanation: not_explicitly_permitted_in_writing_by_copyright_holder is the stated exception. The non-exhaustive examples of commercial purposes appear in section 3.

obligation_items.content: Do not use derivative works for commercial purposes unless the copyright holder has given explicit written permission.
obligation_items.trigger: When use of the derivative work is for a commercial purpose and explicit written permission from the copyright holder has not been given.

clauses.scope_note: Section 2 says any use must satisfy the attribution requirement: credit BigSk1, link the original repository, indicate changes, and avoid suggesting endorsement.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_of_software means the licensee uses the software. attribution_given_in_reasonable_non_endorsing_manner comprises the listed credit, link, change-indication, and non-endorsement requirements.

obligation_items.content: Give appropriate credit to BigSk1, provide a link to the original repository, indicate whether changes were made, and avoid suggesting author endorsement.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the software is used; the attribution may be provided in any reasonable manner that does not suggest endorsement.

clauses.scope_note: Section 2 requires a copy of the license in any redistribution.
clauses.condition_explanation: redistribution means the licensee redistributes the software; license_copy_included means the redistribution contains a copy of this license.

obligation_items.content: Include a copy of this license.

clauses.scope_note: Section 2 requires public forks or derivatives to include a prominent link to the specified original repository.
clauses.condition_explanation: public_fork_or_derivative means the fork or derivative is public. prominent_link_to_original_repository means a prominent link to https://github.com/bigsk1/jarvis-voice is included.

obligation_items.content: Include a prominent link to https://github.com/bigsk1/jarvis-voice.
obligation_items.trigger: When a fork or derivative is public.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3 prohibits removing, altering, or obscuring copyright notices, attribution, or license information.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to the listed notices and information on the software.

obligation_items.content: Do not remove, alter, or obscure copyright notices, attribution, or license information.
obligation_items.object: Software notices, attribution, and license information
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the licensee handles or modifies the software.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3 restricts use of the names Jarvis, BigSk1, or associated branding to endorse or promote products derived from the software, absent prior written permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_of_jarvis_bigsk1_or_associated_branding identifies the named marks or associated branding; the restriction applies only to the stated endorsement or promotion purpose and when prior written permission is absent.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the names Jarvis or BigSk1, or associated branding, to endorse or promote products derived from the software without prior written permission.
obligation_items.object: Names Jarvis or BigSk1 and associated branding
obligation_items.trigger: When the use is to endorse or promote products derived from the software and prior written permission has not been obtained.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3 prohibits making patent claims against the author related to the software.
clauses.condition_explanation: patent_claim_against_author_related_to_software means the licensee makes a patent claim against the author that relates to the software.

obligation_items.content: Do not make patent claims against the author related to the software.
obligation_items.object: Patent claims related to the software
obligation_items.trigger: When a patent claim against the author relates to the software.

clauses.scope_note: Section 5 states that submitted contributions will be licensed under the same terms as this license. The text does not specify a separate downstream relicensing power.
clauses.condition_explanation: contribution_submitted means a pull request, issue, or suggestion is submitted to the project. contribution_licensed_under_same_terms means the contribution is licensed under the same terms as this license.

clauses.scope_note: By submitting a contribution, the contributor grants the copyright holder a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, modify, and distribute that contribution.
clauses.condition_explanation: contribution_submitted means a pull request, issue, or suggestion is submitted. The grant is perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, and royalty-free.

clauses.scope_note: Section 5 grants the copyright holder permission to modify submitted contributions under a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license.
clauses.condition_explanation: contribution_submitted means a pull request, issue, or suggestion is submitted; the grant applies to that contribution.

clauses.scope_note: Section 5 grants the copyright holder permission to distribute submitted contributions under a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license.
clauses.condition_explanation: contribution_submitted means a pull request, issue, or suggestion is submitted; the grant applies to that contribution.

clauses.scope_note: Section 7 provides for automatic termination of license rights if the licensee fails to comply with any license term. It states no cure period.
clauses.condition_explanation: failure_to_comply_with_any_license_term means noncompliance with any term of the license; termination is automatic upon that failure.

clauses.scope_note: Section 7 requires destruction of all copies of the software in the licensee's possession upon termination.
clauses.condition_explanation: license_rights_terminated means rights have automatically terminated following failure to comply with a license term.

obligation_items.content: Destroy all copies of the software in the licensee's possession.
obligation_items.object: Copies of the software in the licensee's possession
obligation_items.trigger: Upon termination of rights under the license.
